key_insight: In a head-to-head benchmark, open-source thigh muscle MRI segmentation tools showed large performance differences, with domain-specific models generally outperforming foundation and general-purpose approaches.
clinical_relevance: Better segmentation can improve MRI-based muscle volume, radiomics, and fat-fraction biomarkers used in neuromuscular disease research and care planning.
method: Benchmarked 8 open-source segmentation tools on 3D thigh MRI volumes.
Compared performance across 3 base datasets and later derived datasets.
Assessed both quantitative accuracy and qualitative usability.
evidence_signal: The study found substantial variation across methods and datasets, with many algorithms performing worse on pathological cases.
watch_item: Results may not generalize well to underrepresented populations or disease patterns, so local validation is important before deployment.
paper_title: Benchmarking open-source automated thigh muscle MRI segmentation algorithms
